tracks.title: Network investigation and testing
tracks.description: Read what a service exposes, test a narrow hypothesis and describe what the evidence supports.

tracks.title: Defensive operations and recovery
tracks.description: Review endpoint activity, put events in context and check that recovery and configuration controls meet their purpose.

tracks.title: Cloud, identity and configuration
tracks.description: Practise access lifecycle, exposure review and audit reasoning before working with a real cloud platform.

labs.title: Asset discovery and inventory
labs.purpose: Compare a saved scan with the authorised asset inventory.
labs.evidence: Saved synthetic scan export and inventory.
labs.deliverable: An inventory of expected, newly observed and unobserved services.
labs.minutes: 30–45 minutes for a first guided pass

labs.title: TCP handshake investigation
labs.purpose: Distinguish a completed handshake, a reset and incomplete evidence.
labs.evidence: Packet summaries with flags, endpoints and frame order.
labs.deliverable: A flow table with packet references and capture limitations.
labs.prerequisites: DNS investigation; client and server roles.
labs.minutes: 30–45 minutes for a first guided pass

labs.title: TLS certificate review
labs.purpose: Check certificate evidence against the intended hostname and observation time.
labs.evidence: Decoded fictional certificate fields and connection context.
labs.deliverable: A certificate review that separates validity checks from trust assumptions.
labs.prerequisites: Names, UTC time and HTTPS basics.
labs.minutes: 30–45 minutes for a first guided pass

labs.title: HTTP headers and cookies
labs.purpose: Review web response settings against the needs of a fictional application.
labs.evidence: Saved response headers and stated application requirements.
labs.deliverable: A short configuration review with specific fixes and limits.
labs.prerequisites: HTTP log triage; requests and responses.
labs.minutes: 30–45 minutes for a first guided pass

labs.title: Vulnerability prioritisation
labs.purpose: Explain which fictional findings need attention first using an explicit local rubric.
labs.evidence: Findings, exposure, service importance, exploitation and confidence.
labs.deliverable: A prioritised queue with reasons, dependencies and uncertainties.
labs.minutes: 30–45 minutes for a first guided pass

labs.title: Remediation and retesting
labs.purpose: Decide whether a claimed fix is demonstrated, incomplete or cannot yet be tested.
labs.evidence: Before-and-after evidence for fictional findings.
labs.deliverable: A retest record with scope, result and the next evidence needed.
labs.minutes: 30–45 minutes for a first guided pass

labs.title: Email identity and message triage
labs.purpose: Compare message identities and destinations with trusted receiving evidence.
labs.evidence: Fictional From and Reply-To headers, extracted link domains and a receiver provenance register.
labs.deliverable: A measured triage note that avoids treating one header as proof of safety.
labs.minutes: 30–45 minutes for a first guided pass

labs.title: Endpoint process investigation
labs.purpose: Use process relationships and approved activity to decide what deserves review.
labs.evidence: Synthetic process records and maintenance context.
labs.deliverable: A process-tree review with benign alternatives and next checks.
labs.minutes: 30–45 minutes for a first guided pass

labs.title: Scheduled task review
labs.purpose: Compare recurring task settings and changes with authorised maintenance.
labs.evidence: Task inventory, execution identities and approval notes.
labs.deliverable: A change-review table for paths, timing and account use.
labs.minutes: 30–45 minutes for a first guided pass

labs.title: Evidence timeline reconstruction
labs.purpose: Normalise event times and show where clock uncertainty limits ordering.
labs.evidence: Fictional logs with offsets and clock-quality context.
labs.deliverable: A UTC timeline that distinguishes reliable order from overlapping time ranges.
labs.prerequisites: Login triage; UTC and time zones.
labs.minutes: 30–45 minutes for a first guided pass

labs.title: Alert correlation and duplicate handling
labs.purpose: Group related records without confusing duplicate alerts with separate incidents.
labs.evidence: Synthetic alert identifiers, event times and correlation criteria.
labs.deliverable: A grouping record showing retained evidence and ambiguous relationships.
labs.minutes: 30–45 minutes for a first guided pass

labs.title: Backup and recovery verification
labs.purpose: Check backup scope, freshness and restore evidence against stated recovery needs.
labs.evidence: Backup inventories, timestamps and synthetic restore-check evidence.
labs.deliverable: A recovery-readiness note with gaps and the next validation step.
labs.minutes: 30–45 minutes for a first guided pass

labs.title: Linux file permission review
labs.purpose: Work out access from owner, group and other permission bits.
labs.evidence: Fictional file modes, directory permissions and identity memberships.
labs.deliverable: An access table explaining the relevant permission class and missing rights.
labs.minutes: 30–45 minutes for a first guided pass

labs.title: SSH configuration review
labs.purpose: Evaluate a small supported configuration against stated administration requirements.
labs.evidence: Saved synthetic configuration and an explicit supported-directive model.
labs.deliverable: A configuration review that identifies unsupported cases and needed verification.
labs.minutes: 30–45 minutes for a first guided pass

labs.title: Cloud storage exposure review
labs.purpose: Reason about public exposure in a deliberately small fictional storage model.
labs.evidence: Storage settings, access rules and stated sharing requirements.
labs.deliverable: An exposure review that preserves necessary sharing and describes model limits.
labs.prerequisites: Access review; public versus private access.
labs.minutes: 30–45 minutes for a first guided pass

labs.title: Joiner, mover and leaver access
labs.purpose: Update access decisions when a person starts, changes duties or leaves.
labs.evidence: Fictional identity changes, effective dates and approved exceptions.
labs.deliverable: A lifecycle action list tied to current duties and timing.
labs.minutes: 30–45 minutes for a first guided pass

labs.title: MFA and account recovery review
labs.purpose: Check enrolment and recovery evidence against explicit account requirements.
labs.evidence: Account types, authentication settings and exception context.
labs.deliverable: A control review that distinguishes enrolment from complete protection.
labs.minutes: 30–45 minutes for a first guided pass

labs.title: Cloud audit-event investigation
labs.purpose: Reconstruct identity and configuration activity from saved audit events.
labs.evidence: Fictional cloud audit records with outcomes and logging coverage.
labs.deliverable: An event handover that separates successful actions, failures and missing evidence.
labs.prerequisites: Login triage; access review; timeline reconstruction.
labs.minutes: 30–45 minutes for a first guided pass

labs.title: Secret handling and exposure review
labs.purpose: Find fictional sensitive values in the wrong places and plan an appropriate response.
labs.evidence: Dummy configuration, changes and logs containing obvious nonfunctional examples.
labs.deliverable: An exposure map and ordered remediation checklist.
labs.prerequisites: File integrity; public and private data boundaries.
labs.minutes: 30–45 minutes for a first guided pass

labs.title: Dependency inventory and advisory review
labs.purpose: Match a small inventory to fictional version-range advisories without assuming exploitability.
labs.evidence: Software inventory, synthetic advisories and deployment context.
labs.deliverable: An affected-version table with recommended verification and update priorities.
labs.prerequisites: Vulnerability prioritisation; basic software version numbers.
labs.minutes: 30–45 minutes for a first guided pass
